column3: Ayase Route ・ Carnage Arc
Kirino, um... There's a reason for this.
We'll get to that later.
First, I have to confirm something.
Are you two actually dating?
Yeah, that's right. We are.
About that... Uh...
Just answer!
...We're dating.
...Really? You're really dating?
You're lying, aren't you?
I mean, you and Ayase... That can't be.
...You're just lying to give me a scare, right?
It's not a lie. We're really dating.
...You're lying.
Say something!
It's not a lie. I'll say this as many times as I have to: We're dating. The reason you haven't seen her much lately is because she's been out with me.
Sorry for keeping it from you.
Ayase... Is that really true?
...Yes.
I'm dating Onii-san.
So it really is true.
Actually, we were going to tell you today.
...I wonder.
Well? Since when? When did you start dating?
On our way back from 【Summer Comiket】, Ayase confessed to me and it just happened.
And why did you even go to 【Summer Comiket】 together in the first place?
Ayase has been worrying about you and wanted to understand your hobbies a bit better, so I took her there.
I can't accept it.
What?
If she confessed during Summer Comiket... She must've already liked you before that, right? How could that be?
Ayase, didn't you say you hated this guy?
Weren't you always going on about how he's some perverted siscon?
Then why... Why did you suddenly end up dating? Isn't that weird?
Ayase, have you been lying to me?
No! It's not like that... Kirino...
It's not Ayase's fault. Why are you so angry?
Huh?!
Something's wrong. Something about this conversation is totally off.
She's jealous and unhappy that I've taken Ayase away from her, right?
Is it just a coincidence that she's putting most of the blame on Ayase?
